description: Refactor llmux Dependency Architecture (Hub-and-Spoke Alignment) - Purify @llmux/core into a provider-agnostic transformation layer, move execution concerns to @llmux/runtime, and eliminate hardcoded provider dependencies.

userStories.title: Create @llmux/runtime package structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a dedicated package for execution interfaces so that Core remains focused on data transformation.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure workspace (bun) to recognize the new package
Verify package builds successfully with `bun run build`

userStories.title: Migrate UpstreamPreparationStrategy to runtime
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to move upstream preparation types out of Core to maintain separation of concerns.
userStories.notes: Types duplicated in runtime and deprecated in core to maintain build stability until US-105

userStories.title: Migrate RateLimitStrategy to runtime
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to move rate limit types out of Core since they are execution concerns.

userStories.title: Migrate ErrorHandlingStrategy to runtime
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to move error handling types out of Core since they are execution concerns.

userStories.title: Update @llmux/server to import from runtime
userStories.description: As a developer, I want server package to use runtime package for execution types.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove deprecated exports from @llmux/core for moved types

userStories.title: Add validateUnifiedRequest hook to SchemaFormat
userStories.description: As a developer, I want formats to validate requests so that provider-specific validation is not in core transform.
acceptanceCriteria: Add optional `validateUnifiedRequest?(request: UnifiedRequest, ctx: FormatContext): void` to SchemaFormat interface
Document the hook purpose in interface comments

userStories.title: Move Gemini schema validation to GoogleGeminiFormat
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Gemini-specific validation in the Gemini format so that core transform is provider-agnostic.
acceptanceCriteria: Move JSON schema anyOf validation from `transform/request.ts` to GoogleGeminiFormat
Update `transformRequest` to call format's validateUnifiedRequest hook

userStories.title: Relocate Gemini-specific utils to provider directory
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Gemini-specific utilities in the Gemini provider directory.

userStories.title: Relocate token estimation utils to Gemini provider
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Gemini token estimation utilities in the Gemini provider directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Update exports in `core/index.ts` to expose via `providers/gemini` namespace or deprecate root export

userStories.title: Move BackoffStrategies to runtime package
userStories.description: As a developer, I want backoff strategies in runtime since they are execution concerns.

userStories.title: Configure ESLint boundary rules for formats
userStories.description: As an architect, I want linting rules to prevent formats from importing providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `no-restricted-imports` rule to biome.json or create eslint override
Verify linter catches a test violation

userStories.title: Configure ESLint boundary rules for core
userStories.description: As an architect, I want linting rules to prevent core from importing server/runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Add rule: `packages/core` must NOT import from `@llmux/server`
Add rule: `packages/core` must NOT import from `@llmux/runtime`

userStories.title: Remove console.log from core registry
userStories.description: As a developer, I want consistent logging in core without console.log.
acceptanceCriteria: Ensure no other `console.log` calls exist in core/src (excluding test files)

userStories.title: Clean up core/index.ts exports
userStories.description: As a developer, I want core public API to not expose provider-specific utilities at root level.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove or deprecate root-level exports for Gemini-specific utils
Remove or deprecate root-level exports for BackoffStrategies
Add JSDoc @deprecated annotations if keeping for backward compatibility
Document new import paths in ARCHITECTURE.md

userStories.title: Verify zero circular dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure there are no circular dependencies in the monorepo.

userStories.title: Final integration test
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all existing tests to pass after the refactor.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `bun run test` across all packages
